comparison_note: The control is the earlier ENV-01 OpenDWM output whose fog prompt was visually ineffective; it is visually clear, but it is not a separately generated no-weather baseline.

video_quality_and_edit_diagnostics.interpretation: PSNR/SSIM quantify edit magnitude here; intentional fog makes them unsuitable as pass/fail realism metrics.

threat_realization.metric_note: Relative contrast/edge/saturation attenuation proxy; it does not estimate physical visibility distance in meters.

ad_decision_impact.metric_note: Open-loop paired decision impact, not a collision/safety-rate estimate.

visual_ad_association.interpretation: Descriptive within-clip association; it does not establish causal effect size across scenes.
